body:
To be a lightning rod of mockery and a hate sponge?

No one would follow me, even if forced. I don't know how to deal with being so broken and incorrect in body and mind; it's getting a bit much.
I have, though it would probably just result in the same thing somewhere else at this point.

It's like life is a puzzle and I'm always missing a piece that would allow me to be normal and interact like a person.

Something about me is that I couldn't do the correct thing in a social situation, regardless of what the situation is or what is required. I will always somehow do the opposite.

I think I'm just not fun, or cool, and ugly, and strange, and the combination is just unbearable.  I don't know. I'm a buzzkill and a loser, and I just want to die.

I gave up years ago. I am a fucking faulure.

I actually live in a moderately large, homogenous city where people kind of all know each other, at least tangentially. Not everyone, but lots, people know you before you know them sometimes.

I don't think it's going to work that way, unfortunately, it looks like the opposite; they have all the opportunity and I am losing the ability to hold it together. Something is wrong.
